component.name: jsLinuxCleanup
component.summary: Free up disk space and see what is installed
Speicherplatz freigeben und sehen, was installiert ist

description.p: Shows what is quietly filling your disk, and what is installed on your machine — including when you last used it.

ul.li: Finds archived logs, downloaded installation files, crash reports, superseded app versions and caches
Rates every entry Safe, Caution or Careful, and says why
Lists system packages, Snaps and Flatpaks together, sortable by size, install date and last use
Shows what starts automatically when you log in
Shows scheduled jobs in plain language and helps you add one
Tells you which updates are waiting
Refuses anything that would break the system, and explains what would go
Deletes only what you ticked, after a confirmation that says it is final

screenshot.caption: Cleanup: categories with size and safety rating
Aufräumen: Kategorien mit Größe und Sicherheitsbewertung
Packages: programs with size, install date and last use
Pakete: Programme mit Größe, Installationsdatum und letzter Nutzung

description.p: Fixes throughout. Single entries inside a category can be picked again, lists keep their position and open folders after a change, and anything that takes a moment now shows a progress dialog instead of a frozen window. Where administrator rights are needed, a lock says so and one click restarts the app with them.
First release. Frees up disk space, shows what is installed and when you last used it, what starts automatically, what is scheduled and which updates are waiting.
